push.title: Notifications on this device
push.hint: Everything that shows in the bell (reminders, new events, polls) also as a notification on this device, for all your clubs.
push.needsInstall: On iPhone and iPad, first add Hubra to the home screen (Share › Add to Home Screen), then switch this on.

privacy.deletionHint: You can ask the club to delete your data. You then leave the club; invoices and bookings stay without your name, because the club has to keep its books. Your Hubra account stays.

privacy.deletionConfirmTitle: Ask for your data to be deleted?
privacy.deletionConfirmBody: Hubra handles your request within 30 days. After that you are no longer a member and your data in the club is deleted. This cannot be undone.
